changes.before: New heroes (guest and registered) started with 0 gold
changes.after: New heroes start with 500 gold — exactly the Stray Egg price, so the first pet is buyable immediately
changes.note: Existing saves untouched. No trading or guild bank exists, so starter gold can't be funneled between accounts.

changes.before: 9Q (9,000,000,000,000,000) — top players were capped out and couldn't earn more
changes.note: Number display now supports the Qi (quintillion) suffix. Server, client, and save validation all use the new cap.

title: Polish patch v15 — player feedback round

changes.before: Boss was re-rolled randomly on every spawn, so the announced boss could differ from the one that actually spawned (e.g. after a death-respawn).
changes.after: Boss identity is deterministic per stage: the announced name always matches the spawned boss, even across re-spawns.
changes.note: Normal (non-boss) enemies stay random for variety. No stat changes.

changes.before: 2 boss names per world — bosses repeated every other boss stage.
changes.after: 8 named bosses per world (32 total), e.g. Throne of Shadows adds The Gloom Empress, Dread Inquisitor Morvain, The Pale Chancellor, Nightmare Herald Xhul, The Thronebreaker, Umbral Pontiff Vexar.
changes.note: Balance-neutral: boss HP/ATK formulas untouched; only names/faces rotate.

changes.before: One-tap kills reset the meter to 0 DPS / 'No damage yet'.
changes.after: The meter keeps the last fight's DPS and shows a 'LAST FIGHT' pill until the next fight lands damage.
changes.note: Session-only display change; no combat numbers affected.

changes.before: Rapid level-ups could stack modal popups on top of each other.
changes.after: Level-up popups queue and show one at a time.
changes.note: UI-only change.

changes.before: Quest kill counters could look frozen/stale on first open; completed quests gave no feedback until the tab was reopened.
changes.after: Quest progress syncs immediately on first open, refreshes live while the tab is visible, and toasts the moment a quest completes (claim button appears without reopening).
changes.note: No quest targets, rewards, or progress math changed.

changes.before: New players were hit with mining, forging, pets, guilds, quests, titles, and professions all at once.
changes.after: New one-time 'New Adventurer Guide' quest chain introduces systems one at a time in order: Battle -> Mine -> Pets -> Forge/Enchant -> Guilds -> Titles -> Professions -> Daily/Weekly quests. Each step unlocks only after the previous is claimed.
changes.note: Rewards use the standard story-quest reward table; no economy changes.

changes.before: Cheapest pet egg cost 5,000 gold — out of reach for brand-new players.
changes.after: New Stray Egg for 500 gold hatches an Ash Mouse (common, weaker than the Cinder Pup — a true starter pet). Marked STARTER in the Pet Shop.
changes.note: Ash Mouse is shop-only (excluded from wild-egg drops). Sells for the standard common-pet formula.

changes.before: No way to remove pets; unwanted pets sat on the bench forever.
changes.after: Sell any non-special pet: rarity base (common 800 / magic 2,000 / rare 5,000 / epic 15,000 / legendary 40,000 / mythic 80,000 / shadow 120,000) x (1 + 15% per level past 1). Two-tap confirm; respects the gold cap; selling the active pet promotes the next pet.
changes.note: A level-10 Void Reaver sells for ~282,000 gold — meaningful, but far below its 500,000 egg price, so buying-to-flip loses money.

changes.before: Top shop egg: Radiant (100,000 gold) -> Ember Fox / Tide Turtle.
changes.after: Mythic Egg 250,000 gold -> Storm Drake / Prismhorn; Shadow Egg 500,000 gold -> Shadow Wisp / Gloomstalker / Void Reaver. New species can also rarely hatch from wild boss-drop eggs (weights 1-2 vs 100 total).
changes.note: Egg prices rise ~2.5x/5x over Radiant; new pets hit ~1.2-1.5x harder than the legendary Tide Turtle via baseDmg 42-56 and growth 1.20-1.21.

changes.before: Enemies were one global random pool at every stage.
changes.after: 4 worlds at stage thresholds: Gloomwood (1-99), Ember Wastes (100-249), The Void Abyss (250-499, new), Throne of Shadows (500+, new). Each has its own enemy/boss roster and ambient background.
changes.note: Balance-neutral by design: enemy HP/ATK formulas are untouched (18x1.125^stage HP, 4x1.085^stage ATK). Worlds change who you fight, not the numbers.

changes.before: No upcoming-content visibility in the Pet Shop.
changes.after: Locked 'Coming Soon' cards for Starlight pets and Shadow demons — visible but unobtainable.
changes.note: Static teasers only; no Seasons system (per standing request).

changes.after: 8 × 1.12^stage (≈153.94M per kill at stage 148)
changes.before: 10 × 1.12^stage (≈192.43M per kill at stage 148)
changes.note: A further 20% off every kill, on top of the v12 nerf. Quest XP is untouched (it scales with the XP curve).

changes.after: Weapon (2 + 1.0×stage), armor (1 + 0.60×stage), helmet (12 + 5.5×stage), before rarity mult
changes.before: Weapon (2 + 0.9×stage), armor (1 + 0.55×stage), helmet (12 + 5×stage), before rarity mult
changes.note: About +10% gear stats from stage ~30 up, so drops keep feeling like upgrades while leveling slows.

changes.after: 18 × 1.125^stage (≈1.41M normal-enemy HP at stage 100)
changes.before: 18 × 1.13^stage (≈2.19M normal-enemy HP at stage 100)
changes.note: Slightly gentler HP curve: −8% at stage 20, −24% at stage 60. Time-to-kill stays honest while XP income drops.

title: Balance patch v13 — XP nerf + pacing tune-up

changes.after: 1.30 exponent for levels 1–60, then 1.42 for 61–70, continuous at 60 (33.93B total XP for 1→70)
changes.before: 80 × 1.30^(L-1) for all 70 levels (19.41B total XP for 1→70)
changes.note: Endgame levels take ~75% more XP; the early game is untouched.

changes.after: 10 × 1.12^stage (≈192.43M per kill at stage 148 — about 176 kills for 1→70)
changes.before: 10 × 1.15^stage (≈9.62B per kill at stage 148 — about 2 kills for 1→70)
changes.note: Farming high stages no longer skips the climb.

changes.after: Capped at +50% inside XP gains (tooltips still show the true total)
changes.before: Uncapped — a Super Galaxy xpBonus pick gave +600% XP (7× leveling speed)
changes.note: Forged gear stays overpowered for combat, just not for leveling.

changes.after: Each rebirth multiplies all XP requirements ×1.35 (×1.35 at 1 rebirth, ×1.82 at 2)
changes.before: Reset to level 1 with identical XP costs every climb
changes.note: The multiplier is shown in the Rebirth panel. The server recomputes XP needs from level + rebirth count and ignores client-supplied values.

changes.after: Guild level capped at 20 (+40% XP max)
changes.before: Uncapped +2% XP per guild level
changes.note: Ships with the guild rework; bounds the biggest XP accelerator.
